name: o-json: edit a JSON object as several lines

actions.label: Make room in the JSON text
actions.caption: enter inserts a new line in this object editor. Lay out a JSON object clearly before accepting it from normal mode.

actions.label: Move down a line of JSON
actions.caption: down moves the text cursor into the object. Navigate its individual lines while keeping the surrounding record visible.

actions.label: Move up a line of JSON
actions.caption: down moves into the object first; up returns to the opening line. Check the braces before accepting a multiline edit.

actions.label: Finish typing before accepting JSON
actions.caption: esc leaves insert mode and keeps this object editor open. Read the JSON in normal mode before enter accepts it.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
